kapak.alt: The sensory limb of the reflex arc

youtube.baslik: Why is there no reflex with a thirty-five decibel loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the example case, the left threshold at 1000 hertz is 35 dB; a cochlear loss of this degree does not usually abolish the reflex. Yet with the stimulus in the left ear there is no reflex at 1000 and 2000 hertz, and at 500 hertz it appears only at 90 dB; with the stimulus in the right ear, reflexes are at expected levels. An absent or elevated reflex when the affected ear receives the stimulus suggests a problem in the sensory limb of the reflex arc and is consistent with the retrocochlear pattern; the finding is not conclusive alone.
